body:
My dear friend,

The Spring Festival is on Friday, and Miss Miriam has asked me to find our best letter-writer to do the invitations. I said: I know just the one!

There's paper on the table by your door.
summary: Write the invitations to the Spring Festival.
done: The invitations are on their way!

tasks.where: at the table by your door
at the coop by your house
